file.content: # Plan: Geo-tiered CTA mode toggle — settings-based buy/trial swap at hydrate level ## Summary Add a `ctaMode` settings flag (values: `default`, `buy-only`, `trial-only`) delivered per locale via the existing MAS-IO settings pipeline. At hydration time in `web-components`, `hydrate.js` reads this flag and suppresses the non-active CTA type from the DOM — no card fragment content is modified. Studio gains a settings UI for admins to configure the mode per geo tier (T1–T4) or individual country. ## Task Description - New `ctaMode` setting definition in `SETTING_NAME_DEFINITIONS` (io/www) - IO settings transformer delivers `ctaMode` in the per-locale settings payload - `hydrate.js` `processCTAs` reads `settings.ctaMode` and: - Hides non-active CTAs (dual-CTA placements: d2p + twp) - Falls back to a Learn More link for single-CTA placements that conflict with the active mode - Fully removes suppressed CTAs from the DOM with `aria-hidden` + `tabindex=-1` - Studio Settings UI: new `ctaMode` field with geo/tier selectors (T1–T4 or individual country) - P1 features (page exclusion engine, CTA pairing enforcement, preview QA) are deferred to follow-on issues ## Relevant Files | File | Action | Reason | |------|--------|--------| | `io/www/src/fragment/transformers/settings.js` | Edit | Add `ctaMode` to `SETTING_NAME_DEFINITIONS` and `SETTING_NAME_BY_VALUE` | | `web-components/src/hydrate.js` | Edit | Add `applyCTAMode()` helper called inside `processCTAs()` using `settings.ctaMode` | | `web-components/src/constants.js` | Edit | Add `CTA_MODE` enum (`default`, `buy-only`, `trial-only`) if not present | | `studio/src/settings/setting-name-map.js` | Edit | Export `ctaMode` definition with editor type `enum` | | `studio/src/settings/mas-settings.js` | Edit | Add geo-tier UI section for `ctaMode` field | | `web-components/test/hydrate.test.js` | Edit | Add unit tests for `applyCTAMode` — dual-CTA suppression + Learn More fallback | | `io/www/test/` | Edit | Add settings transformer test for `ctaMode` extraction and delivery | ## Step by Step Tasks ### 1. Add `ctaMode` to the IO settings definitions - In `io/www/src/fragment/transformers/settings.js`, append to `SETTING_NAME_DEFINITIONS`: ```js { name: 'ctaMode', valueType: 'text', editor: 'enum' } ``` - Confirm `SETTING_NAME_BY_VALUE` map picks it up automatically (it is built from `SETTING_NAME_DEFINITIONS`). - Confirm `extractValue` returns the text value for `valuetype: 'text'` (it does — no extra changes needed to `extractValue`). - Run `node --check io/www/src/fragment/transformers/settings.js` ### 2. Add `CTA_MODE` constant to web-components - In `web-components/src/constants.js`, locate the existing `TWP`/`D2P` block (lines 161–162) and add: ```js export const CTA_MODE = { DEFAULT: 'default', BUY_ONLY: 'buy-only', TRIAL_ONLY: 'trial-only', }; ``` - Run `node --check web-components/src/constants.js` ### 3. Implement `applyCTAMode` in hydrate.js - Add a new exported function `applyCTAMode(footer, ctaMode, learnMoreFallback)`: - Accepts the footer `div[slot]` element, the `ctaMode` string, and an optional `learnMoreFallback` URL. - If `ctaMode` is `default` or falsy, return immediately (no-op). - Identify CTAs with `data-wcs-osi` as checkout links; distinguish d2p vs. twp via `data-plan-type` attribute on the anchor/button (the authoring contract — see Step 6). - For `buy-only`: suppress all elements whose `data-plan-type === 'twp'`. - For `trial-only`: suppress all elements whose `data-plan-type === 'd2p'`. - Suppression = `el.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true'); el.setAttribute('tabindex', '-1'); el.style.display = 'none';` then remove from DOM. - If after suppression no visible CTAs remain (single-CTA placement that conflicts): - If `learnMoreFallback` is provided, inject `Learn More`. - Otherwise log a warning: `console.warn('ctaMode: no CTA remains and no learnMoreFallback configured')`. - Import `CTA_MODE` from `./constants.js`. - In `processCTAs`, after `footer.append(...ctas)` and `merchCard.append(footer)`, call: ```js const { ctaMode, learnMoreUrl } = fields; if (ctaMode) applyCTAMode(footer, ctaMode, learnMoreUrl); ``` - Run `node --check web-components/src/hydrate.js` ### 4. Update Studio setting-name-map.js - In `studio/src/settings/setting-name-map.js`, the map already delegates to `SETTING_NAME_BY_VALUE` from the IO transformer, so `ctaMode` becomes available automatically after Step 1. - No code change needed; verify the import chain is intact. ### 5. Add ctaMode field to Studio Settings UI - In `studio/src/settings/mas-settings.js`, add a new settings section for **CTA Mode** alongside existing settings fields: - Label: `CTA Mode` - A `` (or equivalent) with options: `Default`, `Buy Only`, `Trial Only` — stored as `default`, `buy-only`, `trial-only`. - A geo/tier selector: checkboxes or a multi-select for T1 (`us,gb,fr,de,jp,au,nz`), T2, T3, T4, or specific country locales — stored as locale overrides on the settings fragment. - The UI writes the setting using the existing `settings-store.js` pattern (create/update a settings entry fragment with `name: 'ctaMode'`, `valuetype: 'text'`, `textValue: `, and `locales: []`). - Run `node --check studio/src/settings/mas-settings.js` ### 6. Define authoring contract for `data-plan-type` on CTA links - Document (in a code comment in `hydrate.js`) that authors must set `data-plan-type="d2p"` or `data-plan-type="twp"` on CTA anchor elements in AEM content for the swap to identify CTA type. - Add `learnMoreUrl` to the recognized fields list in hydrate (no new processing needed beyond reading `fields.learnMoreUrl`). ### 7. Write unit tests — web-components - In `web-components/test/hydrate.test.js`, add tests for `applyCTAMode`: - `ctaMode=default` → no CTAs removed. - `ctaMode=buy-only`, dual CTAs (d2p + twp) → twp CTA removed, d2p remains. - `ctaMode=trial-only`, dual CTAs → d2p removed, twp remains. - `ctaMode=buy-only`, single twp CTA, with `learnMoreUrl` → CTA removed, Learn More link injected. - `ctaMode=buy-only`, single twp CTA, no `learnMoreUrl` → CTA removed, warning logged. ### 8. Write unit tests — IO settings transformer - In the IO test suite, add a test confirming `ctaMode` is returned in the settings object when the settings fragment contains a `ctaMode` entry with `valuetype: 'text'`. - Run `node --check` on any new test files. ## Acceptance Criteria - `ctaMode` appears in `SETTING_NAME_DEFINITIONS` and is delivered in the settings payload for any locale. - `hydrate.js` exports `applyCTAMode`; it is called after CTAs are appended to the DOM. - When `ctaMode=buy-only`, all TWP CTAs are absent from the DOM after hydration. - When `ctaMode=trial-only`, all D2P CTAs are absent from the DOM after hydration. - When the conflicting CTA is the only CTA and `learnMoreUrl` is set, a Learn More link replaces it. - Studio Settings UI renders a `ctaMode` picker and geo/tier locale selector; saving writes a settings entry fragment. - No card content fragments are modified at any point. - All new JS files pass `node --check`. ## Validation Commands - `node --check web-components/src/hydrate.js` - `node --check web-components/src/constants.js` - `node --check io/www/src/fragment/transformers/settings.js` - `node --check studio/src/settings/mas-settings.js` - `cd web-components && npm test -- --grep "applyCTAMode"` (after tests are added)
